<?php
class QuietIntEmpty {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I", $incoming, ";";
        return $incoming !== "skip";
    }
    public function __get(string $incoming): int { echo "G", $incoming, ";"; return "0"; }
}
$receiver = new QuietIntEmpty;
$selector = "zero";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($receiver->skip) ? "SKIP;" : "BAD;";
echo $selector === "zero" ? "NAME;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietIntCoalesce {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get($incoming): int { echo "G;"; return "7"; }
}
function quietIntFallback(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietIntCoalesce;
$selector = "value";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietIntFallback()) === 7 ? "SEVEN;" : "BAD;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietIntFallback()) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietIntAssign {
    private int $value = 41;
    public bool $present = true;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $this->present; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): int { echo "G;"; return "0"; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "S", $value, ";"; $this->value = $value; }
}
function quietAssignRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietIntAssign;
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietAssignRhs()) === 0 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD;";
$receiver->present = false;
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietAssignRhs()) === 9 ? "SET;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";
